entities.summary: Christopher Domenic Iannetta is an American former professional baseball catcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Colorado Rockies, Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim, Seattle Mariners, and Arizona Diamondbacks. He played in college for the North Carolina Tar Heels of the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. He stands 6 feet 0 inches (1.83 m) tall, and weighs 230 pounds (100 kg).
